title: spec(automation-api): `innerRefusal` is still described as "the refusal a node's write met"; a read or a script node's function-name refusal fills it too
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by landed work: the contract review of PR #33390, card #32379, comment 6882343575, finding N1; the dev's `out_of_scope_findings` carried it with `carrier: none`)

**What is wrong.** `packages/spec/src/api/automation-api.zod.ts` on `main` still describes `innerRefusal` as "the refusal a node's write met" in three places: the JSDoc of `FlowInnerRefusalSchema` (near L319), the `.describe` on `AutomationResult.innerRefusal` (near L463), and the `.describe` on `FlowFailureDetailsSchema.innerRefusal` (near L640), plus the JSDoc near L605. The generated reference `content/docs/references/api/automation-api.mdx` mirrors the wording. Since PR #32257 (ADR-0150 D3), a `script` node whose `config.function` is ambiguous or outside its `dependencies` closure also fills it, with `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, and `get_record`'s catch arm carries a read refusal through the same `refusalCarriedBy`. PR #33390 corrects the api skill; the spec's own text still under-describes.

**Reach.** Read in the code: `refusalCarriedBy` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/inner-refusal.ts`) runs in all four data-node catch arms of `builtin/crud-nodes.ts` (`get_record` included) and in the `script` node's package-scoped `resolveFunction` refusal (`builtin/screen-nodes.ts`). The descriptions ship in `@objectstack/spec` and in the generated API reference.

**Business reason.** Client and agent authors read the schema descriptions and the API reference to write flow-door error handling; "a node's write" tells them a read or a function-name refusal never lands there.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:spec` seat: wording-only `.describe` and JSDoc edits plus the regenerated reference, one changeset (`'@objectstack/spec': patch`, `Clause-②: no`).

**Dedupe.** `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue innerRefusal describe`: 6 hits, the only open one is #32379 (the skill text, PR #33390). `… innerRefusal "write met"`: 2 hits, same.

Suggested-grade: p3 (description wording; no accept-set change).
